title: Convergent evolution of metabolic regulation governs redox adaptation in Toxoplasma.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Downloaded both GEO processed files. GSE329845_Processed_Data.csv.gz: 8,635 gene rows (TGGT1 gene IDs) x 12 raw-count columns (wild-type vs mutant TgPRO, vehicle vs actinomycin D, 3 replicates each). GSE327264_Processed_RIP-Seq_Reads.csv.gz: 8,636 gene rows x 10 raw-count columns (input vs RIP pull-down, 5 pairs, uneven replication). Neither file has a label, enrichment or p-value column. PRIDE PXD077563 (TMT-16plex, tandem mass tag, whole-proteome mass spectrometry) exists publicly; raw files not opened.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only; the full text returned HTTP 500 and the supplement (where the genome-wide CRISPR screen fitness table would be) was not retrievable. Screen size, scoring and hit lists unverified.

a1_downloadable.note: Two GEO count tables downloaded openly; PRIDE project public. CRISPR screen table not retrievable (supplement endpoint failed).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked in files: only raw read counts. Any label (TgPRO-bound transcript, TgPRO-regulated gene) must be constructed by running differential enrichment on 2-3 replicates per arm.

a3_inputs_present.note: Only TGGT1 gene IDs; 3' UTR (untranslated region) sequences would have to be pulled from ToxoDB, the Toxoplasma genome database, and UTR boundaries are poorly annotated.

a5_enough_rows.note: 8,636 genes, but the real unit is the experiment (5 RIP/input pairs, 12 RNA-seq libraries); bound-transcript positives likely tens to low hundreds, count not verified.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Not checkable without full text; gene counts consistent with the ~8,600-gene T. gondii GT1 annotation.

a8_label_provenance.note: Counts are physical measurements (RIP-seq, RNA-seq); no circularity, but the label is not yet derived.

backbone.name: RNA-FM (RNA language model) on 3' UTR sequences, hypothetically

integration.partner_dataset: ToxoDB genome-wide CRISPR fitness scores (Sidik et al. 2016) and UTR annotations
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Do 3' UTR sequence motifs predict which Toxoplasma transcripts a parasite-specific RNA-binding protein controls?

controls.positive_control: ISCU transcript, shown in the paper to be bound via its 3' UTR, should rank as a bound target.
controls.external_validation: None found; no independent TgPRO binding dataset.

honest_claim_h3: At best: a sequence model separates transcripts enriched in one RIP-seq experiment from unenriched ones, among ~8,600 genes of one parasite strain, with a handful of noisy replicates.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the 3' end sequences of parasite messenger RNAs to predict which ones a new parasite RNA-binding protein grabs.
plain_idea.train_on: One example per Toxoplasma gene (8,636 in the file): its 3' untranslated sequence, fetched separately from the genome database.
plain_idea.predict: Whether the gene's transcript is enriched in the protein pull-down versus input, a label we would have to compute from 5 noisy input/pull-down count pairs.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Parasite biologists would get a motif-level guess at other targets of TgPRO, but the label set is tiny and self-constructed.

label_elsewhere.sources: No other TgPRO binding data known; label exists only in this paper.
label_elsewhere.why: Not filled in depth because the verdict is reject.

ml_idea: Predict TgPRO-bound transcripts from 3' UTR sequence using RIP-seq enrichment as label; rejected because the label must be built from a few replicates and positives are few.

effort.compute_note: Estimated only; files are tiny, cost is in UTR retrieval and label construction.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Run DESeq2-style enrichment on the RIP counts and count significant bound transcripts; under ~200 kills it.

verdict_reason: Fails A2/A3/A5 (checked in files): GEO data are two small gene-by-sample raw count matrices (12 and 10 libraries) with no label column, gene IDs only, and few experimental units; the CRISPR screen table was not retrievable. Existing-models search skipped after Part A failure.
